materials.name: Aluminum alloys
materials.use: Lightweight housings, precision fixtures, heat sinks and structural brackets.
materials.note: Specify alloy, temper and stock form. High-strength grades and formable sheet grades serve different purposes.

materials.name: Stainless steel
materials.use: Valve parts, fluid interfaces, fasteners and corrosion-resistant enclosures.
materials.note: Match the grade and heat-treated condition to corrosion, hardness and machining requirements.

materials.name: Carbon & alloy steel
materials.use: Shafts, couplings, machine frames, mounting plates and load-bearing hardware.
materials.note: Specify hardness, heat treatment and protective finish; bare carbon steel needs corrosion protection in many environments.

materials.name: Sheet & coated steel
materials.grades: Cold-rolled · hot-rolled · galvanized · electrogalvanized · SPCC · SECC · SGCC · S235 · S355
materials.use: Amplifier chassis, equipment cabinets, ventilation panels and mounting brackets.
materials.note: Give thickness in mm or inches, bend requirements and coating condition. Regional grades require drawing review.

materials.name: Tool steel
materials.use: Wear inserts, punches, dies and production tooling.
materials.note: Define final hardness and grinding allowance. Heat treatment can change dimensions.

materials.name: Brass
materials.grades: C260 · C360 · lead-free grades by specification
materials.use: Turned fittings, threaded inserts, decorative hardware and electrical terminals.
materials.note: Identify lead restrictions, plating requirements and the exact alloy for fluid-contact applications.

materials.name: Copper & bronze
materials.use: Busbars, heat-transfer parts, bushings and bearing components.
materials.note: Choose copper for conductivity or bronze for bearing applications; they are not direct substitutes.

materials.name: Titanium
materials.use: Lightweight structural parts and corrosion-resistant precision components.
materials.note: Specify material condition, cosmetic faces and any required material documentation.

materials.name: Casting alloys
materials.grades: Aluminum A380 · ADC12 · zinc Zamak 3 / 5 · magnesium AZ91D
materials.use: Complex housings, covers and repeat-production cast components.
materials.note: Alloy selection, draft, wall sections and secondary machining are reviewed together.

materials.name: ABS, PC & blends
materials.use: Enclosures, acoustic waveguides, covers and impact-resistant interfaces.
materials.note: Specify resin grade, color and any UV or flame-rating requirements.

materials.name: Acetal / POM
materials.use: Gears, rollers, bushings and precision sliding components.
materials.note: Review load, wear, dimensional tolerances and the selected resin grade.

materials.name: Nylon / polyamide
materials.use: Wear pads, mechanical brackets, gears and durable housings.
materials.note: Moisture conditioning and reinforcement affect dimensions and performance.

materials.name: Polyolefins
materials.use: Chemical-handling parts, guides, liners and flexible containers.
materials.note: Review creep, stiffness and bonding requirements before final selection.

materials.name: Clear plastics
materials.use: Windows, display covers, light guides and transparent guards.
materials.note: Define optical areas, scratch protection and clarity expectations separately from mechanical tolerances.

materials.name: High-performance polymers
materials.grades: PEEK · PEI / ULTEM · PPS · PSU · PPSU · PBT · PET
materials.use: Insulators, demanding mechanical interfaces and temperature-exposed components.
materials.note: Use grade-specific data for temperature, chemicals, reinforcement and regulatory requirements.

materials.name: Fluoropolymers & PVC
materials.use: Seals, insulating parts and chemical-handling components.
materials.note: Material behavior and processing routes differ. Specify the operating medium and temperature.

materials.name: Silicone & rubber
materials.use: Gaskets, seals, boots and vibration-isolation components.
materials.note: Specify Shore hardness, compression, fluid exposure and any required test standard.

materials.name: TPE, TPU & cast urethane
materials.grades: TPE · TPU · rigid and flexible polyurethane
materials.use: Soft-touch grips, protective covers, flexible interfaces and short-run parts.
materials.note: State hardness, color and the substrate for any overmolded bond.

materials.name: Composites & laminates
materials.use: Insulating plates, stiff panels, fixtures and lightweight brackets.
materials.note: Specify laminate construction, fiber direction and edge-quality requirements.

materials.name: Powder-bed polymers
materials.grades: PA11 · PA12 · glass / carbon / mineral-filled nylon · PP · TPU · PK
materials.use: Complex ducts, brackets, lattice components and functional prototypes.
materials.note: The available grade depends on the print platform. Define stiffness, flexibility and cosmetic needs.

materials.name: FDM thermoplastics
materials.grades: ABS · ASA · PLA · PETG · PC · PC/ABS · nylon · reinforced nylon · PEI
materials.use: Jigs, fixtures, large prototypes and low-volume functional parts.
materials.note: Build direction, layer height and fill strategy are part of the specification.

materials.name: Photopolymer resins
materials.grades: General-purpose · tough · clear · high-temperature · rigid · flexible · rubber-like
materials.use: Detail models, fit checks, visual prototypes and resin-specific functional parts.
materials.note: Choose the actual resin by datasheet. An ABS-like resin is not the same material as molded ABS.

materials.name: Metal printing powders
materials.use: Complex metal geometries, internal channels and consolidated assemblies.
materials.note: Alloy availability depends on process. Specify stress relief, machining and inspection needs.

finishes.name: As-machined & deburred
finishes.benefit: Retains visible tool paths with burr removal.
finishes.spec: Identify edge breaks, sharp edges to retain and required surface roughness.

finishes.name: Bead blasting
finishes.benefit: An even matte appearance on visible surfaces.
finishes.spec: Specify media, cosmetic faces and areas to mask.

finishes.name: Brushing & mechanical polishing
finishes.substrate: Stainless steel, aluminum, brass and other suitable metals
finishes.benefit: Directional grain or a polished decorative surface.
finishes.spec: State grain direction, polish level and an approved reference sample.

finishes.name: Tumbling / vibratory finishing
finishes.benefit: Batch edge smoothing and surface blending.
finishes.spec: Review delicate features, edge radii and dimensional allowances.

finishes.name: Type II anodizing
finishes.benefit: Clear or colored oxide finish for decorative and protective use.
finishes.spec: Specify color, thickness, sealing and masking; approve a color sample.

finishes.name: Type III hard anodizing
finishes.benefit: A thicker anodic layer for wear-focused applications.
finishes.spec: Define coating allowance, final fits and required specification.

finishes.name: Chemical conversion / chem film
finishes.benefit: A conversion layer for corrosion protection or paint preparation.
finishes.spec: Specify chemistry, class, electrical-contact areas and drawing standard.

finishes.name: Passivation
finishes.benefit: Removes surface contamination and free iron after manufacturing.
finishes.spec: State the required process specification and any verification tests.

finishes.name: Electropolishing
finishes.benefit: Electrochemical smoothing and brightening.
finishes.spec: Account for material removal and define internal or critical surfaces.

finishes.name: Black oxide
finishes.benefit: A dark conversion finish with minimal dimensional buildup.
finishes.spec: Define alloy, sealing or oil treatment and corrosion expectations.

finishes.name: Electroless nickel
finishes.benefit: A deposited nickel layer for wear and corrosion requirements.
finishes.spec: Specify phosphorus content, thickness, masking and post-treatment.

finishes.name: Zinc plating
finishes.benefit: Sacrificial corrosion protection for hardware.
finishes.spec: Specify thickness, passivate color and any embrittlement-relief requirements.

finishes.name: Gold & silver plating
finishes.benefit: Contact surfaces and decorative metallic finishes.
finishes.spec: Define base layers, plated areas, thickness and electrical requirements.

finishes.name: Copper & tin plating
finishes.benefit: Conductive layers, solderable surfaces or plating underlayers.
finishes.spec: Specify the complete coating stack and local masking requirements.

finishes.name: Hard chrome & specialty plating
finishes.benefit: Wear-oriented or drawing-specific plated surfaces.
finishes.spec: Provide the exact coating specification; specialty chemistries are reviewed per project.

finishes.name: Powder coating
finishes.benefit: Durable color and texture for housings, frames and panels.
finishes.spec: Give RAL reference, gloss, texture, thickness and masked faces.

finishes.name: Wet painting
finishes.benefit: Color-controlled cosmetic and protective paint systems.
finishes.spec: Specify primer, topcoat, color, gloss and adhesion requirements.

finishes.name: Ceramic-polymer coating / Cerakote
finishes.benefit: Thin decorative and protective coating systems.
finishes.spec: Specify product series, color, cure compatibility and coating thickness.

finishes.name: Phosphate & dry-film lubricants
finishes.benefit: Surface preparation or reduced-friction treatment.
finishes.spec: Provide chemistry, lubricant system, coating thickness and application zones.

finishes.name: Heat treatment
finishes.benefit: Adjusts bulk material properties rather than simply surface appearance.
finishes.spec: Specify condition, hardness, stress relief and post-treatment inspection.

finishes.name: Precision cleaning & masking
finishes.benefit: Controlled cleaning and protection of functional areas during finishing.
finishes.spec: State cleanliness criteria, packaging and excluded surfaces; oxygen-service requirements need a defined procedure.

finishes.name: Sanding & support removal
finishes.substrate: FDM, SLA, DLS and other supported prints
finishes.benefit: Removes supports and blends selected contact areas.
finishes.spec: Identify cosmetic faces and acceptable remaining layer lines.

finishes.name: Depowdering & media blasting
finishes.benefit: Removes loose powder and evens the printed surface.
finishes.spec: Review internal-channel access and delicate features.

finishes.name: Vapor smoothing
finishes.benefit: Reduces surface texture on selected printed polymers.
finishes.spec: Confirm resin compatibility, critical dimensions and the desired appearance.

finishes.name: Color dyeing
finishes.benefit: Adds color to porous printed polymer surfaces.
finishes.spec: Specify color reference and acceptable batch variation.

finishes.name: Clear coat & gloss finishing
finishes.benefit: Improves cosmetic gloss or apparent clarity.
finishes.spec: Define clear areas and viewing requirements; this is not an optical-grade guarantee.

finishes.name: Painting & plating for plastics
finishes.substrate: Suitable printed, cast or molded polymers
finishes.benefit: Decorative color or a metal-coated appearance.
finishes.spec: Review adhesion, resin compatibility and coating stack.

finishes.name: Secondary machining & thermal processing
finishes.benefit: Finishes critical features after the primary build.
finishes.spec: Identify machined datums, threaded features and thermal treatment requirements.

finishes.name: SPI A: polished
finishes.benefit: A-1, A-2 and A-3 polished tooling for glossy molded surfaces.
finishes.spec: Select the SPI grade, resin and cosmetic faces; validate the molded result.

finishes.name: SPI B: semi-gloss
finishes.benefit: B-1, B-2 and B-3 finishes for a softer sheen.
finishes.spec: Specify the grade and review draft and part geometry.

finishes.name: SPI C: matte
finishes.benefit: C-1, C-2 and C-3 stone-finished tooling for lower-gloss parts.
finishes.spec: Define cosmetic zones and the acceptable texture reference.

finishes.name: SPI D: textured
finishes.benefit: D-1, D-2 and D-3 blasted tooling for textured surfaces.
finishes.spec: Review draft, resin flow and texture uniformity.

finishes.name: VDI 3400 texture
finishes.benefit: Numbered texture levels for fine-to-coarse matte appearances.
finishes.spec: State the VDI number and approve a physical texture sample.

finishes.name: Mold-Tech & custom texture
finishes.benefit: Specified grain patterns and custom decorative textures.
finishes.spec: Provide the exact texture reference, draft requirements and approval sample.

finishes.name: Cast-part color & texture
finishes.benefit: Pigmented, smooth, matte or textured cast surfaces.
finishes.spec: Specify master pattern finish, color, hardness and visible surfaces.

note: Original Metalcorex copy. Owner confirmed service scope. Grade and process combinations require quotation review.
